_readme: Townlapse town registry. Add one entry per town (a pull request is welcome). 'slug' becomes townlapse.org/<slug>; 'url' is where the town's map lives (here, or on its own domain).

towns.name: Downtown Palo Alto
towns.blurb: 1900 to today. More than 2,000 places, from the 1904 city directory and decades of phone books to today's shops, plus the ones neighbors remembered.

towns.name: Downtown Santa Rosa
towns.blurb: Railroad Square to Courthouse Square, 1900 to today. The stone buildings that survived 1906, the courthouses, theaters and department stores that didn't, and today's shops from OpenStreetMap.
